## Summary

[Partial] Remove skid plates, drill out cross member holes, then shave plate thickness or replace shocks. [t141]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

2. [Partial] Drill out any stripped threaded holes in the cross member where the plate mounts.

## Tools

- [Partial] Drill [t141]

## Tips & gotchas

- Shave down the thickness of the skid plate to reduce contact area if rubbing persists after re-threading. [t141]
- Consider replacing Bilstein shocks with OME units as a potential alternative for creaky noises. [t141]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Assuming stripped threads are not causing expansion issues when the frame is hot and torqued. [t141]
